propositions.name: michelson_morley_negative_result
propositions.statement: The Michelson-Morley experiment gave a negative result in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling in the direction of the earth's motion and the other in a perpendicular direction.
propositions.quote: The well-known negative result of the Michelson-Morley experiment in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion, and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction

propositions.name: aether_shares_earth_motion_interpretation
propositions.statement: The negative result of the Michelson-Morley experiment is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion

propositions.name: stellar_aberration_favours_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Stellar aberration favours the opposite theory of a stationary aether.
propositions.quote: other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether

propositions.name: fitzgerald_lorentz_contraction_hypothesis
propositions.statement: Solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.
propositions.quote: solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions, when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for

propositions.name: larmor_case_for_contraction
propositions.statement: A good case may be made out for the view that solid bodies alter their relative dimensions when rotated.
propositions.quote: Larmor (' Æther and Matter ,' Cambridge, 1900) has shown that a good case may be made out for this view.

propositions.name: aether_motion_may_cause_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A deformation of matter when moving through the aether might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction.
propositions.quote: such a deformation of matter when moving through the rather might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction

propositions.name: double_refraction_testable_with_delicacy
propositions.statement: The beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy.
propositions.quote: as the beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy, I thought that even a small chance of arriving at a positive result justified a careful experiment

propositions.name: liquids_no_double_refraction_from_motion
propositions.statement: In liquids there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, comparable with the single refraction.
propositions.quote: the conclusion may be stated that there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, that is comparable with 10 of the single refraction

propositions.name: electric_stress_causes_double_refraction_in_liquids
propositions.statement: The liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress.
propositions.quote: the liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress, as is shown in Dr. Kerr's experiments

propositions.name: light_polarized_by_nicol_45_degrees

propositions.name: transverse_motion_exhibits_double_refraction
propositions.statement: When the board stands north and south the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue.
propositions.quote: When at 12 o'clock the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue

propositions.name: vibration_direction_relative_to_motion_hypothesis
propositions.statement: Luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion might be propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, i. e. east and west, are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion, i. e. vertical

propositions.name: east_west_orientation_no_double_refraction
propositions.statement: If the board points east and west, both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, so no double refraction could manifest itself.

propositions.name: no_effect_from_180_degree_rotation

propositions.name: ninety_degree_effect_second_order_velocity_ratio
propositions.statement: Such effect as a rotation through 90 degrees may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.

propositions.name: earth_orbital_and_solar_motion
propositions.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space.
propositions.quote: according to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space

propositions.name: suns_motion_towards_hercules

propositions.quote: The latter is supposed to be much the smaller, and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules

propositions.name: april_motions_conspire
propositions.statement: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the motion of the earth in its orbit and the motion of the sun in space would approximately conspire.
propositions.quote: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire

propositions.name: strained_glass_produces_double_refraction
